name: BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads
description: This connector allows Claude to query Amazon Ads data for sellers and vendors with a BidX account (https://bidx.io). It enables users to use Claude to perform audits on their Amazon Ads data through BidX, generate charts, provide recommendations on Amazon Ads budgeting, own-brand and competitor ASIN tracking, and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.bidx.io/mcp/sql. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads provides these MCP tools: discover-sql-schema, get-current-advertiser, list-available-advertisers, run-sql-query, and switch-advertiser.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: BidX - Scale Marketplace Ads is developed by BidX GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
